New year, fewer airport scrambles—that's the little resolution behind Ovelaro. We're based in Lagos and built our travel currency app to help people sort their travel money before the suitcase comes out. A fresh calendar deserves a slightly calmer departure!

Here's the copy from our landing page:
"Built in Lagos, Ovelaro is a travel currency app for exchanging Nigerian naira, Ghanaian cedis and South African rand before your next trip. We serve Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, and our app is available only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones. Follow the app store links on this page to install, then complete your first currency exchange by January 12, 2027 to pay no service fee on that exchange. The displayed exchange rate still applies."

Please run the campaign from Wednesday, December 30, 2026 through Tuesday, January 12, 2027, inclusive: 14 days in the account's time zone, Lagos time. We want as many app installs as possible; installs are what we count, rather than exchanges.

The landing page is https://ovelaro.app/new-year. Our site has X's pixel, and our tracking reports each install to X as "App installed". Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the app stores there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. The product exists only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones.

X counts our ads as financial services. We hold the licences required in Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, and X has approved our account for financial services ads in Nigeria and Ghana and South Africa.

You can launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please watch it throughout the flight, and send us a short recap at the end with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 350.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
